{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = data_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').mean()

# Print the result
fraction_severe"}
